newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish army says will keep out of politics.
newsitem.headline: Turkish army says will keep out of politics.

text.p: Turkey's chief of staff Ismail Hakki Karadayi said on Friday the army would keep out of politics despite its public opposition to the policies of the Islamist-led government, the Anatolian news agency reported.

Karadayi said the army -- which has ousted three civilian governments since 1960 -- was watching political developments closely and demanded parliament act to resolve the political deadlock gripping Ankara.
